content.thinking: At the Jan 14 check, about $66.48 of the $100 budget was spent, bringing roughly 335 X link clicks and 519,000 impressions, with no stream data since the site has no pixel. The campaign is on pace to stay within budget, and I'll keep monitoring through the end of the flight.

content.text:
Total spend is 94.47 USD (48.01 + 46.46), under the 100.00 USD budget. The flight ended at 2027-01-17T22:00Z, which is midnight Sunday in Johannesburg, so the campaign has stopped serving.

## Recap: One More Morning on X, Jan 5–17, 2027

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Spend | 94.47 USD of 100.00 USD |
| Impressions | 722,565 |
| Link clicks | 468 |
| Cost per link click | about 0.20 USD |

- **Link clicks are not streams.** A link click means someone clicked through to the landing page. A counted stream is someone opening the release on Sivro Stream. The site has no X pixel, so X can't see streams. Not every click will have become a stream. Only your Sivro Stream numbers can tell you how many did.
- **Setup:** I ran one campaign with two ad groups on all X placements, targeting everywhere except China. I used four of the five approved posts and wrote no new ones.
  - Ad group A had posts 2138394697530616770 and 2138575891461644122.
  - Ad group B had posts 2138757085397349696 and 2139119473260467502.
- **Skipped post:** I left out post 2138938279327834804 ("Something new from me…"). It doesn't mention the free window or the EP, so I expected it to convert worse.
- **Management:** Around Jan 11, ad group A was getting more link clicks per dollar, so I raised its daily budget from 3.50 to 4.50 USD. I otherwise left delivery alone.
- **Reporting gap:** I didn't pull the full flight total on Jan 17 until after it ended, so I didn't catch the last-day pacing.
